texts.SamplePageMessage: A sample page for the Site module
texts.Site:010001: The route '{Route}' is already used by another page.
texts.Site:010003: '{Route}' is not a valid route: it contains a placeholder that is not recognized.
texts.Site:010004: A page cannot be organized under itself or under one of its own child pages.
texts.Site:010005: The page '{Name}' still has child pages; delete or move them first.
texts.Site:020001: A content type named '{Name}' already exists on this page.
texts.Site:020002: The field '{FieldId}' is referenced more than once by this content type.
texts.Site:030002: The field '{Name}' is a platform preset and cannot be deleted. Remove it from a content type's arrangement instead of deleting the definition.
texts.Site:030003: The field '{Name}' is a platform preset and cannot be renamed. Its display name can still be changed.
texts.Site:040001: The slug '{Slug}' is already used by another '{CultureName}' content on this page.
texts.Site:040002: The content type '{ContentTypeId}' belongs to a different page than the one given.
texts.Site:040003: A draft cannot have a publish time in the future ('{PublishTime}'). Set status to Published to schedule it for then.
texts.Site:040004: This page's route ('{Route}') has no slug placeholder, so its content cannot have a slug ('{Slug}' given).
texts.Site:040005: This page's route ('{Route}') requires a slug for every content beneath it; an empty slug is not allowed here.
texts.Site:050001: This site has no primary domain configured, so absolute URLs cannot be generated. Set the 'Primary domain' setting.
texts.Description:Site.EnabledLanguages: Comma-separated culture names (e.g. "en,fr,zh-Hans") this site serves. The first one is the default language: its URLs carry no language prefix, while the others are served under "/{culture}/".
texts.Description:Site.PrimaryDomain: The site's primary absolute address, e.g. "https://example.com". Sitemap, robots.txt, feeds and canonical URLs are all built on it, so that a custom domain and a platform subdomain never compete as duplicate content. Leave empty to use the address each request arrives on.
texts.Description:Site.EnableLlmsTxt: Publish an /llms.txt index of this site's pages. Optional and off by default: adoption is around 10% and Google has stated it does not support it, so it is not a ranking mechanism.
texts.Description:Site.Robots.AllowIndexing: Whether search engines are allowed to index this site.
texts.Description:Site.Robots.AllowAiTraining: Allow crawlers that train AI models (GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, CCBot).
texts.Description:Site.Robots.AllowAiSearch: Allow crawlers that power AI search/RAG answers (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot).
texts.Description:Site.Branding.AppName: The site's display name. Empty uses the platform default.
texts.Description:Site.Branding.LogoUrl: Logo shown on a light background. Empty uses the platform default.
texts.Description:Site.Branding.LogoReverseUrl: Logo shown on a dark background. Empty uses the platform default.
texts.ContentTypeStillHasContents: This content type still has contents; delete or move them first.
texts.Validate:InvalidSeoValue: The value of '{0}' is not a valid SEO field value.
texts.DisplayName:Page.Name: Name
texts.Description:Page.Name: The page's identifier, used by MCP tools and templates. Lowercase, no spaces.
texts.Description:Page.Route: The path template this page is served at. No placeholder means no content beneath it, e.g. "/about". "{slug}" resolves content beneath it and requires every content to have one, e.g. "/blog/{slug}"; "{slug?}" does the same but also allows one content with an empty slug at the page's own address, e.g. "/about/{slug?}". Any other field of the content can appear too, e.g. "/news/{publishTime:yyyy-MM}/{slug}" - a ":FORMAT" suffix may only use letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' (no '/').
texts.Description:Page.ParentId: The page this one is organized under in the admin UI. Organizational only - it does not affect routing. Leave empty for a top-level page.
texts.PageMoveHomePageRejected: The home page cannot have a parent.
texts.PageMoveCycleRejected: A page cannot be moved under its own descendant.
texts.DisplayName:ContentType.Name: Name
texts.Description:ContentType.Description: Written for AI, not just for people: an MCP client picks the right content type by reading this. Say what belongs here and what does not.
texts.NoFieldsArranged: No fields yet. Add one from the field library.
texts.ContentTypeSwitchHint: Switching the content type replaces the fields below with that type's. Anything typed into a field the new type does not have is discarded.
texts.RenameFieldWarning: Renaming a field rewrites the stored value of every content that uses it. This cannot be undone from here.
texts.DisplayName:Field.Name: Name
texts.Description:Field.Name: The key this field's value is stored under. Change it only through Rename.
texts.Description:Field.Description: Written for AI, not just for people: an MCP client relies on this to fill the field correctly. Say what goes in it.
texts.Description:Field.Group: A filing label for the library. Pick an existing one or type a new one.
texts.UngroupConfirmMessage: This removes {0} field(s) from the '{1}' group. The fields themselves are not deleted.
texts.FieldTypeNotSearchable: This field type has no query index, so it cannot be searched.
texts.FieldTypeFixedAfterCreation: A field's type cannot be changed after it is created.
texts.SlugSlotTaken: The page's own address is already used by another content.
texts.DraftPublishTimeDisabledHint: A draft is never public, so a publish time would do nothing. Set the status to Published to schedule it.
texts.PageFilterRequiredForFieldColumns: Pick a page to see its content type's fields as columns.
texts.Seo:NoIndexHint: Exclude this content from the sitemap and emit a noindex robots tag.
texts.Seo:CharLimitAdvisoryHint: These limits are guidance, not validation. A search engine truncates an over-long title or description rather than rejecting it, so a longer value still saves.
